clock: Finite UTC Unix seconds; future evidence is unavailable
history: One atomic current snapshot per root; preserve each action's last successful completion across failures
redaction: No endpoints, private IDs, resource names, plans, provider diagnostics, credentials or exception text
producer: 06a trusted workflows must publish running and terminal results, including failures before apply; interrupted running evidence expires
export: metrics() exports only allowlisted bounded series; exporter and scheduling are not active
alerts: Failure, drift, unavailable, missing and stale evidence require explicit root/action workflow_enabled=1
unconfigured: No enabled workflow means unavailable evidence, never automatic monitoring or successful infrastructure
delivery: Lab alerts cannot replace independent public outage monitoring
